says: In next/, ProcessManager.dead checks for an earlier dead entry by reading the whole <process>/dead stream and searching it for one key, where a lookup by id would read one row.
proof: ProcessManager.ts:445 runs [...turn.read(stream, 0)].find((entry) => entry.id === key && entry.by === caller.by) on `${process}/dead`.
cost: Each dead letter reads every earlier dead letter of that process, so a process that keeps dead-lettering pays n squared over 2 rows.
